messages.text: Anacortes cannery, Wednesday 14 October 2026. Review retort basket {{basket}}. The cook card says 242 F for 74 minutes. The sockeye in that basket is for the tender Retort.
Happy to. What should I focus on for basket {{basket}}?
The come-up time and whether 74 minutes is enough. Name the tender Retort. Answer in two short sentences.
